## What this project is

Ninja Tournament is an unofficial, clean-room, fan-made 3D browser game inspired by the discontinued 2015 LEGO Ninjago Tournament mobile arena game.

It is a community/open-source remake project, not an official LEGO release and not affiliated with or endorsed by LEGO, TT Games, Hellbent Games, or other rights holders.

## Current playable features

- 51 playable fighters.
- 3D arena combat in the browser.
- Elemental kick effects and fighter-specific combat themes.
- Spinjitzu.
- Tornado of Creation team ultimate in Free Play.
- Permanent fighter upgrades using studs.
- Half-heart and full-heart health drops.
- Tournament, Challenge, Dojo, Fighters, Gallery, controls and loadout systems.
- Keyboard, gamepad and mobile touch controls.
- Progressive Web App support and a Capacitor Android packaging path.

## Technology

- TypeScript
- Vite
- Three.js
- Playwright
- Capacitor

## Clean-room and IP policy

The repository does not distribute extracted APK/OBB files, proprietary source code, ripped official models, textures, music, sound effects, logos, animations, or other unauthorized assets from the discontinued commercial game.

LEGO, NINJAGO, character names and other third-party trademarks/copyrighted works remain the property of their respective owners. The MIT license does not grant rights to third-party intellectual property.
